CGU.title: Terms of Use
CGU.intro: Welcome to Haux Alerte. By using this application, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and accepted these terms.

legal.title: 1. LEGAL NOTICES AND PURPOSE
legal.content:
1.1. Service Editor
The Haux Alerte application is edited by the citizen initiative 'HAUX C'EST VOUS', represented by Sophie RICAUD.
Contact: S.RICAUD2026@GMAIL.COM

1.2. Nature of the service (Important Warning)
This application is a private initiative in the context of the 2026 municipal elections. It is in no way an official service of the Haux City Council. Reports made on this platform do not trigger immediate technical intervention by current municipal services. They are intended to identify needs for the future municipal program.

1.3. Hosting
The application and data are hosted by: Vercel Inc. (Infrastructure and Photo Storage) and Neon (Database).

access.title: 2. ACCESS AND REGISTRATION
access.content:
2.1. Authentication
Access to reporting features requires authentication via Google or a Magic Link sent by email. You are responsible for the security of your email access.

2.2. Trust System (User Roles)
To guarantee the quality of information:
- New users ('Newcomer'): You can send reports (type and photo), but adding text descriptions is restricted.
- Confirmed users ('Citizen'): This feature unlocks automatically after validation of several relevant reports by our administrators.

privacy.title: 3. PERSONAL DATA (GDPR)
privacy.content:
In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), here is how we process your data:

3.1. Collected Data
- Mandatory: Email address (for authentication and notifications).
- Functional: Geolocation during reporting, date, and time.
- Content: Photos and descriptions of road issues.
- Technical: Session cookies necessary for operation.

3.2. Purpose
Your data is used exclusively to authenticate your account, locate incidents on the map, and notify you by email of the progress of your report.

3.3. Your Rights
You have the right to access, rectify, erase, limit, oppose, and request the portability of your data. To exercise these rights, contact: S.RICAUD2026@GMAIL.COM.

3.4. Access by Authorities
Your data is confidential. It will not be shared with third parties except in cases of judicial requisition, serious and imminent danger, or manifest criminal offense.

moderation.title: 4. OPERATION AND MODERATION
moderation.content:
4.1. 'A Priori' Moderation
Any submitted report is placed in 'PENDING' status. It is not publicly visible until it has been manually validated by an administrator.

4.2. Content Rules and Photos
Formal Prohibitions: photos allowing identification of faces or license plates without prior blurring, insulting or discriminatory remarks, photos of private gardens or interiors not visible from the public highway.

Photos are stored on Vercel Blob and are accessible via a secure URL for display purposes.

4.3. Rejection Reasons
Duplicate, private property, outside jurisdiction, lack of information, or inappropriate content.

4.4. Sanctions
In case of serious abuse (spam, insults), administrators may permanently ban your account.

responsibility.title: 5. LIABILITY
responsibility.content:
5.1. Emergencies
Haux Alerte is not an emergency service. For any serious and imminent danger (accident, gas leak), immediately contact emergency services (18 or 112) or the Gendarmerie (17).

5.2. Limitation of Liability
The 'HAUX C'EST VOUS' initiative declines all liability for technical impossibility to access the service, inaccuracy of user-provided data, or delays in resolving reported issues.

ip.title: 6. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
ip.content: By submitting a report, you grant 'HAUX C'EST VOUS' a non-exclusive, free, and worldwide license to use this content for project needs. The source code, design, and logo remain the exclusive property of their respective authors.

evolution.title: 7. EVOLUTION OF TERMS
evolution.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Users will be informed of any substantial modification by email. Continued use of the application constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

jurisdiction.title: 8. APPLICABLE LAW AND JURISDICTION
jurisdiction.content: These Terms of Use are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute that cannot be resolved amicably, the competent courts will be those within the jurisdiction of the Court of Appeal of Bordeaux.
